image_description: A large, ornate pipe organ mounted on a wall or balcony within a church-like setting. The instrument features a rich reddish-brown wooden case with multiple sections of vertical silver metallic pipes of varying heights. The central section has the tallest pipes, flanked by shorter pipes in symmetrical arrangements. Below the main pipe array is a lower section with additional smaller pipes and a decorative panel featuring two painted faces/figures. To the left, a Gothic-style arched window with leaded glass is visible. To the right, a hanging lantern-style light fixture and part of a statue are seen. The perspective is slightly low-angle, looking up at the organ.
